params.body:
Replaces #210 (two assertions failed in CI without showing the output; the tests now capture it).

`php artisan stocklist:smoke {service?} {--all} {--spend-tokens} {--chassis=} {--dealer=} {--whatsapp-to=}`: one read per integration with fixed data, one line per service (✓ ✗ –), exit 1 on any failure. Never creates anything at a third party.

| service | what it does | when it is skipped |
|---|---|---|
| db | one count | |
| storage | exists() of a photo original in the bucket + length of a signed md URL, says whether the own presigner or the SDK signed | no photo with derived sizes |
| mail | Mail::raw to the dealer address; on staging the seal routes it to the log and the line says so | production (nothing sent) |
| realgarant | fresh login (getToken(true)), then getPrograms() for the dealer's newest vehicle with RealGarant codes; reports token time and counts | not in OUTBOUND_ALLOW; dealer without credentials |
| flexlease | getFlexLeaseInfo() for the newest eligible vehicle (VAT vehicle, < 4 years, <= 50,000 km, fuel FlexLease knows); asserts price_excl > 0 | not in OUTBOUND_ALLOW; no eligible vehicle |
| blurit | login (the cheapest read: a token, no task queued) | not in OUTBOUND_ALLOW; config missing = fail |
| mollie | methods->allActive() with a test_ key | live key (never touched); package placeholder key |
| vwe | delegates to stocklist:vwe-smoke | without --spend-tokens (each lookup is billed) |
| openai | VehicleTextService::generate() for a small fact set | without --spend-tokens |
| whatsapp | one Dutch test message via WhatsAppService, reports the message id | only with --whatsapp-to=+32... (never in --all, never scheduled); not in OUTBOUND_IMPACT |

Scheduled daily at 07:10 (`--all`, so without VWE/OpenAI/WhatsApp) into the log. CUTOVER.md step 5 gets the run right after the switch; CLAUDE.md lists the command.

Tests (Feature, MariaDB in CI): argument guard; sealed services reported as off with exit 0; FlexLease price read through Http::fake (and the failure path); RealGarant fresh login through Http::fake; WhatsApp only with the option and respecting OUTBOUND_IMPACT; --all never includes WhatsApp.

Locally the worktree cannot autoload new classes (vendor symlink autoloads the main tree), so only `php -l`; the local main tree has no database. CI decides.

On staging: `php8.5 artisan stocklist:smoke --all`, expected lines like
```
Omgeving staging (verzegeld), dealer Peugeot De Backer (#1)
✓ db          2796 wagens in de databank (3 ms)
✓ storage     origineel aanwezig in de bucket, md-URL van 412 tekens (eigen presigner) (120 ms)
✓ mail        naar de log, zoals verzegeld (8 ms)
✓ realgarant  token in 380 ms, 3 formules en 12 contracten voor wagen #21795 (1450 ms)
✓ flexlease   wagen #21790, Benzine: € 527,94 excl. per maand (620 ms)
✓ blurit      login geeft een token (300 ms)
– mollie      geen MOLLIE_KEY
– vwe         overgeslagen (kost een token; --spend-tokens en --chassis=...)
– openai      overgeslagen (kost tokens; --spend-tokens)
```
then `--whatsapp-to=+32...` with an own number for WhatsApp (needs whatsapp in OUTBOUND_IMPACT on staging).
params.title: stocklist:smoke: integration smoke test, one line per service
